'''Hanoch Gutfreund''' ({{Langx|he|חנוך גוטפרוינד}}; born 1935 in Kraków, Poland) is the Andre Aisenstadt Chair in [[theoretical physics]] and was the president at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]]. Prior to his presidency, he was a professor at the university.

==Biography==

Gutfreund received a Ph.D. in [[theoretical physics]] from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1966.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://elsc.huji.ac.il/faculty-staff/hanoch-gutfreund |title=Hanoch Gutfreund &#124; ELSC |publisher=Elsc.huji.ac.il |date= |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref><ref name="mpiwg-berlin1">{{cite web|url=https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/users/hgutfreund |title=Hanoch Gutfreund &#124; MPIWG |publisher=Mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de |date= |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref>

Gutfreund is the Andre Aisenstadt Chair in Theoretical Physics and has been a professor at the university since 1985.<ref name="mpiwg-berlin1"/><ref>{{cite web|author=Alan Posener |url=https://www.welt.de/kultur/article154427053/Einstein-mochte-den-Begriff-Relativitaet-nicht.html |title=Ein Interview mit Hanoch Gutfreund über Albert Einstein - WELT |publisher=Welt.de |date=2016-04-17 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref> Gutfreund was earlier the Head of the Physics Institute, Head of the Advanced Studies Institute, Rector, and President of the university from 1992 to 1997 (following [[Yoram Ben-Porat]], and succeeded by [[Menachem Magidor]]).<ref name="mpiwg-berlin1"/><ref>{{cite web|last=Kim |first=Meeri |url=https://www.lindau-nobel.org/de/the-einstein-legacy-project-celebrates-100-years-of-general-relativity/ |title=The Einstein Legacy Project Celebrates 100 Years of General Relativity &#124; Lindauer Nobelpreisträgertagungen |publisher=Lindau-nobel.org |date=2016-06-29 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Barak |first=Naama |url=https://www.israel21c.org/the-little-train-that-could-teach/ |title=The little train that could... teach |publisher=ISRAEL21c |date=2009-11-23 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://new.huji.ac.il/en/page/454 |title=Office of the President &#124; האוניברסיטה העברית בירושלים &#124; The Hebrew University of Jerusalem |publisher=New.huji.ac.il |date=2017-09-01 |accessdate=2020-02-18}}</ref>

Gutfreund is the Director of the Einstein Center and is Hebrew University's appointee responsible for [[Albert Einstein]]'s [[intellectual property]].<ref name="mpiwg-berlin1"/><ref>[https://www.fromthegrapevine.com/arts/albert-einstein-archives-letters-son-friend-calculations-lasers-hebrew-university-jerusalem "Einstein Archives unveil 110 never-before-seen items,"] March 6, 2019.</ref><ref>Ilan Ben Zion (March 6, 2019). [https://apnews.com/71c58ed6cf2a4236939bc203a1531f75 "Hebrew University adds new manuscripts to Einstein archive,"] AP.</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.haaretz.com/science-and-health/2015-11-27/ty-article/.premium/einstein-promises-an-enjoyable-challenge/0000017f-f73e-d460-afff-ff7e9d460000 |title=Einstein promises an enjoyable challenge|work=Haaretz |date=2015-11-27 |access-date=2020-01-21}}</ref> He heads the executive committee of the [[Israel Science Foundation]].<ref name="mpiwg-berlin1"/>

His writings include ''The Formative Years of Relativity: The History and Meaning of Einstein's Princeton Lectures'' (with [[Jürgen Renn]], [[Princeton University Press]], 2017) and ''The Road to Relativity: The History and Meaning of Einstein's "The Foundation of General Relativity", Featuring the Original Manuscript of Einstein's Masterpiece'' (with Jürgen Renn, Princeton University Press, 2017), and ''Einstein on Einstein: Autobiographical and Scientific Reflections'' (with Jürgen Renn, Princeton University Press, 2020).<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=C3GYDwAAQBAJ&q=%22Hanoch+Gutfreund%22 |title=The Formative Years of Relativity: The History and Meaning of Einstein's Princeton Lectures |author=Hanoch Gutfreund, Jürgen Renn  |publisher=Princeton University Press|date=2017 |isbn=9780691174631 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fXGYDwAAQBAJ&q=%22Hanoch+Gutfreund%22 |title=The Road to Relativity: The History and Meaning of Einstein's "The Foundation of General Relativity", Featuring the Original Manuscript of Einstein's Masterpiece |author=Hanoch Gutfreund, Jürgen Renn  |publisher=Princeton University Press |date=2017 |isbn=9780691175812 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=dJoyywEACAAJ&q=%22Hanoch+Gutfreund%22 |title=Einstein on Einstein: Autobiographical and Scientific Reflections |author= Jürgen Renn, Hanoch Gutfreund  |publisher= Princeton University Press|date= 2020|isbn=9780691183602 |accessdate=2020-01-21}}</ref>

Gutfreund lives in Jerusalem.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160117080123/http://www.pbs.org/wgbh/nova/blogs/physics/author/hanoch-gutfreund/ "Hanoch Gutfreund,"] PBS.</ref>
